jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Reliability Test (R5532)
jobs.description_text: As a Reliability Test Engineer at Shield AI, you'll prepare, execute, and manage environmental tests on electronic flight hardware across the VBAT and XBAT aircraft, ensuring it meets performance requirements through rigorous thermal, vibration, shock, humidity, and altitude testing. This is a highly hands-on role. Working with design and reliability stakeholders, you'll define test plans — stress profiles, sample sizes, and pass/fail criteria — then bring them to the bench: designing and modeling test fixtures in CAD, instrumenting hardware with thermocouples, accelerometers, strain gauges, and humidity sensors, configuring data acquisition, and programming and loading chambers. You'll frequently run several campaigns at once, owning the equipment scheduling needed to keep them moving without compromising data quality. Once tests are running, you'll operate the equipment, monitor for and investigate failures, and reduce and document results in clear reports — including the plots and visualizations stakeholders rely on to make disposition and qualification decisions. You'll work with cutting-edge deep-tech hardware, collaborate across disciplines, and directly influence product quality and long-term reliability over the vehicles’ lifecycles.

As a Senior Software Test & Automation Engineer, you will design and develop automated test infrastructure, execute system-level verification activities, analyze software performance, and build the tooling that enables continuous validation throughout the development lifecycle. Working closely with autonomy software, systems engineering, digital infrastructure, and flight test teams, you will help ensure autonomy capabilities are validated, repeatable, and ready for operational deployment.

Consistent with AHEAD's Consultant capability tier, this role is the engine of an engagement: day-to-day contact for analyst- and manager-level client stakeholders, and owner of a discrete enterprise change and transformation deliverable or workstream. The Consultant structures sub-problems, develops hypotheses, and produces client-ready work with limited supervision, while beginning to informally coach Associates.

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description_text: As a Field Marketing Manager, you will lead the development and execution of integrated marketing plans that generate awareness and drive pipeline growth across AHEAD’s Central Region. This highly collaborative role partners closely with marketing, sales, and external agencies to align strategy, ensure flawless execution, and report on performance and outcomes. Serving as the primary bridge between the Central Region and the broader marketing organization, you will ensure tight coordination across teams, consistency in messaging and branding, and effective activation of campaigns, partner initiatives, and regional deliverables. You’ll also champion regional engagement in national campaigns—helping to localize content, refine audience targeting, and align messaging to meet regional business needs. The ideal candidate brings a strong track record in field marketing and a hands-on approach to execution. This position reports directly to the Director of Field Marketing. It offers a unique opportunity to make a direct and measurable impact on regional business growth.

jobs.title: Financed Contracts Billing and Collections Specialist
jobs.description_text: The Financed Contracts Billing and Collections Specialist manages the billing, payment tracking, collections, reconciliation, and cash-application activities associated with customer-financed receivables. This role owns the operational flow from approved financing documentation through invoice submission, payment follow-up, reconciliation, and funding or cash application. The specialist works closely with AHEAD’s Finance and Accounting Department, Financial Solutions Group, Financial Solutions Leads (FSLs), and leasing partners to ensure that financed transactions are billed accurately, payments are collected on time, records remain complete and traceable, and exceptions are resolved through the appropriate financial channels. This is a hands-on role for a highly organized, detail-oriented professional who is comfortable working with contract and financial data and confident managing professional businessto-business payment communications.

jobs.title: Launch Associate, Product Engineer
jobs.description_text: LAUNCH – Join AHEAD's Associate Development Program Our Mission: to attract and develop a diverse community of THE top IT consulting talent in the country and build AHEAD’s next generation of leaders. LAUNCH serves as the foundation to develop our talent into high potential leaders at AHEAD. By exposing you to a variety of career paths and building your acumen across different practices in the business, we’re accelerating your growth and career trajectory at AHEAD. Our development program is built on a foundation of technical training, completion of certifications, and shadowing, all supported by an ecosystem of AHEADians that will be part of your Launch journey, every step of the way! You’ll grow and develop key skills that will support your development as a technical and consulting expert. If you’re ready to begin an exciting career in IT Consulting, LAUNCH is where you should be! jobs.title: Lead Hardware Returns Specialist
jobs.description_text: The Lead Hardware Returns Specialist is responsible for leading the daily processing of defective, damaged, non-conforming, and customer-owned computer hardware for return to manufacturers and vendors. This role performs the core functions of the Hardware Returns Specialist while providing day-to-day direction, coordination, training, and operational support for the returns team. Ensures accurate product verification, documentation, inventory control, RMA processing, vendor returns, and outbound shipments. The role is also responsible for monitoring department performance, resolving process issues, supporting cross-functional communication, and helping maintain consistent operations across multiple facilities located on the same campus.The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, process-driven, technically capable, and able to lead by example in a fast-paced warehouse and reverse-logistics environment. The position requires flexibility to work in and provide coverage for multiple campus facilities as business needs require.

jobs.title: Principal Technical consultant-AI
jobs.description_text: As a Principal Technical Consultant, AI Services, you are responsible for the hands-on delivery of AI solutions within AHEAD client engagements. You are an engineer and client-advisor - you turn solution designs into working, production-grade GenAI / Agentic AI workflows, and you take them all the way into production - deployed, running, and reliable in live client environments. You will collaborate with clients and interdisciplinary teams, which includes engineers, product owners, domain experts to understand real business needs and solve complex challenges across industries. You will work alongside senior consultants and architects, contribute to the technical direction and own delivery.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Consultant | Cloud & AI | Platform Engineering
jobs.description_text: Join AHEAD's Rapid Solutions Team as a Rapid Solutions Pod Lead, a role that spans engagement leadership, people leadership, client delivery, and offering development. You will be the primary point of accountability for every engagement in your pod, from the first client conversation through the executive readout, owning scope, governance, cadence, and outcomes. You will also lead a small pod of engineers, setting their goals and coaching their growth, so the team behind each engagement is as strong as the engagement itself. Beyond delivery, you will own the evolution of the Rapid Solutions offering, refining the playbooks, templates, and delivery standards that keep the practice repeatable and scalable. This role sits within AHEAD's AI & Cloud Practice, so engagements center on helping clients modernize and optimize across multi-cloud platforms, platform engineering, and AI-driven solutions. You'll bring that focus to bear on every Rapid Assess and Rapid Solutions engagement your pod delivers.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Consultant, Data
jobs.description_text: The Senior Technical Consultant is an experienced, client-facing technical professional responsible for leading the design and hands-on delivery of complex data, analytics, AI, cloud, and modern data platform solutions. Operating between the Technical Consultant and Principal Technical Consultant levels, the role combines deep technical execution with solution leadership, consultative problem solving, client engagement, and team enablement. Senior Technical Consultants independently own significant technical workstreams and solution components, translate business and technical requirements into scalable implementations, guide other engineers, and ensure work is tested, documented, secure, maintainable, and production-ready. They are expected to lead through technical credibility and hands-on delivery while escalating enterprise architecture, cross-workstream governance, or critical technical decisions to the Principal Technical Consultant or Solution Architect when appropriate. Beyond client delivery, Senior Technical Consultants strengthen the Data Practice by mentoring less-experienced technical consultants, contributing reusable engineering patterns and standards, supporting technical discovery and proposal development, and continuously expanding expertise across modern data, cloud, governance, analytics, and AI technologies.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Consultant, Modern Apps
jobs.description_text: This hands-on delivery role within the Modern Apps practice focuses on building software: designing, writing, testing, debugging, and deploying production-quality code within client engagements. The ideal candidate brings strong coding ability, sound engineering habits, a growing sense of technical judgment, and a passion for delivering high-quality software faster through effective use of AI-assisted development tools. Technical Consultants own defined features, components, and small workstreams end to end. They operate with day-to-day independence while working inside the technical direction set by a Senior or Principal Technical Consultant, and are trusted contributors on delivery teams building and modernizing web applications, mobile applications, APIs, functions, and related platform services. In Modern Apps, this role is especially well suited to engineers who are excited about AI-native software delivery. Candidates should be productive daily users of tools such as Claude Code and have experience using AI to accelerate coding, testing, debugging, documentation, and other parts of the software development lifecycle.

jobs.description_text: ウーブン・バイ・トヨタについて ウーブン・バイ・トヨタは、トヨタの100年に一度のモビリティ・カンパニーへの変革に寄与していきます。「自分以外の誰かのために」発明を続けたという歴史からインスピレーションを受けた私たちのミッションーそれは、モビリティの定義を拡げ、そしてモビリティが社会に貢献する方法を拡張し、人を想うイノベーションで、モビリティの常識に挑み続けることです。 私たちは4つの柱を中心に活動しています：自動運転・先進運転支援システム技術のAD/ADAS、SDV（ソフトウェア定義車両）のための車両ソフトウェア生産プラットフォームであるArene、モビリティのテストコースであるWoven City、そして協業基盤を支えるデジタル・インフラストラクチャのCloud & AIです。また、ビジネスに不可欠な機能がこれらのチームの実装を下支えし、一丸となって「事故ゼロ社会」と「幸せの量産」の実現に向けて取り組んでいます。 ========================================================================= チームについて Teammate Driving (POV BEV) チームは、自動運転システムにおける最も基本的な機能の1つである車線維持機能と、自動運転システムで使用される地図情報提供サービスを開発しています。テストエンジニアのミッションは、システム要件に基づいて実装されたソフトウェアの機能、性能、品質基準を設定し、評価し、設計者にフィードバックし、製品の性能と品質を向上させることです。また、これらの製品をトヨタの次世代運転支援システム「Toyota Safety Sense」と「Teammate」に実装し、世界中の顧客により安全な運転とより快適なモビリティを提供します。 求める人材 私たちは、ソフトウェアのパフォーマンスと品質を向上させるために、AD/ADAS車両評価の運用と問題分析を行い、問題解決を推進できるエンジニアを探しています。また、ソフトウェアエンジニア、テストドライバ、さまざまな協力者と良好な関係を築くために、新しい価値を提案し、効果的にコミュニケーションできる人材を求めています。尚、定期的に東京・日本橋のオフィスに出社し、静岡県東富士のテストコースで実地試験の実施が必要となります。 業務内容 プロジェクトの進捗状況に合わせた評価計画の策定と管理 システム要件を満たすテストシナリオの作成 実車でのテストと特定された問題の原因の特定 アジャイル開発における問題管理と解決の推進 必須条件 以下のスキルと経験が必要です。 ・技術 ・車両評価業務 ・ユーザー視点でソフトウェア要件が満たされていることを検証する能力 ・Gitによるソフトウェア管理能力 ・AD（自動運転）/ADAS（先進運転支援システム）に関する知識と各技術の相互作用の理解 ・管理 ・優れた問題解決能力、仮説検証能力、タスク管理能力 ・ドキュメンテーション能力 ・さまざまな情報を体系化し、首尾一貫した計画を立案する能力 ・言語 ・日常的な場面で使われる日本語を理解できる能力。（例：日本語能力試験N2以上、または同等のレベル）

jobs.description_text: About Xsolla Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. About the Role We're looking for a Staff Engineer to own the smart wallet and account abstraction layer of Xsolla's Web3 platform. This is an individual contributor role with outsized technical scope: you'll be the technical anchor for how millions of players get an on-chain account they never have to think about — setting direction, making hard architectural calls, and raising the bar across the org. Concretely, you'll own the account model behind Xsolla ZK, our zkSync-based L2, and the wallet that sits inside Xsolla App. Every player who signs in with Xsolla ID receives a deterministic, non-custodial smart account — derived from their identity claim, identical on every device, with private keys that never leave the client. You'll own the primitives underneath all of it: the ERC-4337 user operation lifecycle, EIP-7702 delegation, session keys and origin-bound Smart Sessions, paymaster and gas abstraction strategy, and the custody and recovery roadmap — including the move from raw key export to MPC custody. jobs.title: Senior Photonics Engineer, Optical Interfaces
jobs.description_text: PsiQuantum’s mission is to build the first useful quantum computers—machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems. Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries. Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry—including partners like GlobalFoundries—we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don’t feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure. In 2024, PsiQuantum announced government-funded projects to support the build-out of our first utility-scale quantum computers in Brisbane, Australia, and Chicago, Illinois. These initiatives reflect a growing recognition that quantum computing will be strategically and economically defining—and that now is the time to scale. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Command Centre (Frontend & UI/UX)
jobs.description_text: The Role You will build the Command Centre, the screen an operator uses to see what our robots and cameras see, decide in seconds, and task the fleet. Soldiers have already run our console unaided after a short introduction. Next, one operator watches many sites, and tasks robots in plain language instead of drawing routes. That needs an interface built for it. This role is engineering and design in one. You will shape the flows, prototype them, test them with operators, and ship them in production code, working with our full-stack engineer on the backend and our vision engineers on what the models show. What You'll Work On Operator interface: live video, site maps, robot positions and alerts in one view that works at 03:00. Alert triage: the flow from alert to decision: evidence, context, confirm or dismiss, dispatch a robot. Tasking by instruction: an interface for telling the fleet what to do in plain language, and seeing how it plans to do it. Design system: components and patterns that keep the product consistent as it grows. Usability: prototype, test with operators, measure, iterate. Performance: real-time streams and many sites without the interface slowing down. Who We're Looking For A frontend engineer with real UI/UX craft, who has shipped data-heavy, real-time interfaces that people rely on under pressure. Your Background 3+ years of frontend engineering with TypeScript and React. Shipped real-time, data-heavy interfaces: maps, video, dashboards or control panels.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Simulation (Digital Twins)
jobs.description_text: The Role You will be the first engineer on our Simulation team. Every site we map becomes a digital twin, built from our own lidar maps, and in it our robots see thousands of the intrusions, fires and sensor failures a real site sees once a year. Our multi-robot patrol policy was trained in simulation in under two hours on a single GPU and ran unmodified on real robots at three sites. Your job is to make that repeatable for every site and every new skill. You will work with our Skills & Orchestration engineers, who train learned skills with reinforcement learning, and with our Reliability & Test Infrastructure engineer, who runs regression in the same simulator. What You'll Work On Map to twin: a pipeline from our lidar maps to simulation-ready digital twins: geometry, semantics, materials, sensors. Training environments: RL environments for learned skills such as multi-robot patrol and search, randomised so nothing overfits one site. Rare events: generate the scenarios real sites rarely produce: intrusions, sabotage, weather, sensor failures. Sensor simulation: RGB, thermal and lidar realistic enough that what is learned in the twin holds on the robot. Sim-to-real: measure the gap on real deployments and close it. Scale: many parallel environments on GPUs, fast enough that a new skill trains in hours. Who We're Looking For A simulation engineer who treats the simulator as production infrastructure and measures success by what transfers to real robots. Your Background 3+ year

jobs.title: Research Scientist, Foundation Model (World Model & Site Memory)
jobs.description_text: The Role You will own the research question at the centre of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world: can a model learn what normally happens on a site, by place, hour and weather, so that an anomaly is simply what it did not expect? The first version is a probabilistic memory of each site. The next is a world model across every site that predicts the next state in latent space, starting from open world-model weights and growing on field data nobody else holds. Our robots and cameras run on live security sites around the clock, and every event is kept with its clip, the model's verdict and the operator's outcome. That record is your dataset. You will work alongside our perception and model engineers, and your results go into production, not only into papers. What You'll Work On Site memory: a learned, probabilistic model of each site: which people, vehicles and robots are where, at what hour, in what weather, and how the scene usually unfolds. Anomaly as surprise: replace rule-based alerting with measured surprise, and work out how to evaluate it when real incidents are rare. World model: post-train open world-model weights on aligned multi-sensor field sequences, JEPA-style, predicting in latent space rather than pixels. Transfer: from one site's memory to a model of all of them, and representations that carry across sites and domains. Research direction: choose the questions, design the experiments, and decide what is true before it ships. Who We're Looking For A re

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Robot Autonomy (Reliability & Test Infrastructure)
jobs.description_text: The Role You will own the path a code change takes from commit to robot, and the evidence behind every gate on that path. Today the honest answer to "is this build safe?" is "it worked on the test robot." You will replace that with a system: the simulation environment the team tests against, the regression suites that run on every change, the hardware-in-the-loop rigs, and the release gates that decide whether a build can go onto a robot that will patrol a customer site alone tonight. This is the first engineer dedicated to reliability and test infrastructure, and it sits in our Robot Autonomy team, next to the engineers building perception, localisation, planning and locomotion. Our robots patrol security sites, critical infrastructure and defence facilities without a human present, so a bad release is not a rollback: it is a customer incident. Within six months, nothing should reach a customer robot without passing something you built. What You'll Work On Release pipeline: code change, automated tests, simulation at scale, staging robot, pilot site, full rollout, with explicit pass criteria at every gate and nothing advancing without meeting them. Simulation as infrastructure: a GPU-backed simulation environment (Isaac Sim today) running continuously, so engineers test against scenarios instead of queueing for the one robot in the lab. You start on well-scoped parts of that engine, next to the engineers who built it, and grow into owning them. Your code runs in the factory. What We're Looking For Foundations . Degree in computer science, mathematics, mechanical engineering or a related field, with real depth in geometry, linear algebra and numerics. Internships, thesis work or serious side projects count. We do not expect years of production experience. B-rep Basics . You are comfortable with topology, NURBS, meshes and point clouds. You may never have shipped a robust boolean, and you still understand why floating-point robustness destroys naive implementations, and you want to learn how the field handles it. Kernel Exposure . You have worked with a geometry kernel and mesh libraries in at least one project: OpenCASCADE, CGAL, libigl, Open3D, PCL, Parasolid or comparable.
